units: Num. R. s. 1932 (ref. to Deut. III, 11) וכאן עושה אותו ש׳ (ed. Wil. a. oth. שירים) and here he is represented as a survival.—Pl. שְׁיָירִים, שְׁיָרִים; du. שִׁירַיִים, שִׁירַיִם.
<cite ref="Mishnah Menachot 2:1">Men. II, 1</cite> <he>הקומץ … שְׁיָרֶיהָ וכ׳</he> if a priest takes a handful of the meal-offering with the intention of eating its remnants … the next day.

<cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 2:10">Ruth R. to I, 5</cite> (ref. to <he>ותשאר</he>, <cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 2:10">ib.</cite>) <he>נעשית שְׁיָרֵי שירים</he> she became like the remnants of remnants (of the meal-offering); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 600:7">Yalk. ib. 600</cite> <he>נעשית שירים</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Eruvin 2:5">Erub. II, 5</cite>, a. e. <he>שבעים אמה וש׳</he> seventy cubits and a balance (less than eighty); Y. ib. II, 20ᵇ <cite ref="U01976"><he>שריים</he></cite> (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Zevachim 52a:13">Zeb. 52ᵃ</cite> <he>שירי חטאת</he> the remaining blood of the sin offering after sprinkling (<cite ref="Leviticus 4:34">Lev. IV, 34</cite>, a. e.).

<cite ref="Leviticus 4:34">Ib.</cite> <he>ש׳ אין מעכבים</he> the pouring out of the remaining blood at the bottom of the altar is not indispensable for the efficacy of the sacrifice (v. <cite ref="P00712"><he>עָכַב</he></cite>); <cite ref="Meilah 9a:40">Meïl. 9ᵃ</cite> <he>ש׳ מעכבים</he> it is indispensable; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Menachot 9:8">Men. IX, 8</cite> <he>סמיכה שירי מצוה</he> the laying of hands on the victim is the last of the commendable acts, i.e. is not indispensable.

<cite ref="Menachot 93b:7">Ib. 93ᵇ</cite> <he>אם עשאה לסמיכה ש׳ מצוה</he> if he treated the laying on of hands as dispensable (omitted it); Sifra Vayikra, N’dabah, Par. 3, ch. IV; <cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 14:10">Neg. XIV, 10</cite>; a. e.—

<cite ref="Megillah 15b:4">Meg. 15ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <he>לשאר</he>, <cite ref="Isaiah 28:5">Is. XXVIII, 5</cite>) <he>למי שמשים עצמו כש׳</he> for him that considers himself like leavings (is modest); <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 16b:6">R. Hash. 16ᵇ</cite> sq. (ref. to <he>לשארית</he>, <cite ref="Micah 7:18">Mic. VII, 18</cite>).—<he>שְׁיָירוֹת</he>, <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 19:33">Num. R. s. 19<sup>21</sup></cite> ed. Wil., v. <cite ref="U00841"><he>שִׁיּוּר</he></cite>.
